summary: Remedy's paranatural action series and connected FBC spin-offs; primary picks favor PC where it offers the broadest visual feature set and current content.

entries.title: Control

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows native with high-end PC rendering features

primary.why: The Ultimate Edition includes The Foundation and AWE expansions, and Windows remains the most flexible route for high-end rendering features, display options, and archival capture.
primary.how_to_play: Play Control Ultimate Edition on Windows via Steam, GOG, Epic, or the Xbox/PC storefront with ray tracing/DLSS or equivalent settings enabled where hardware supports them.

entries.remaster_caveats: Switch and Luna are cloud routes; Stadia is historical only; Apple-device releases are useful but hardware-limited. Use Ultimate Edition for the expansion-complete playthrough.

entries.title: FBC: Firebreak

emulation.notes: Native Windows client is required for the primary route.

primary.why: Windows is the most flexible route for a current online co-op shooter, with PC storefront support and cross-platform multiplayer.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows version through Steam or Epic with friends; verify server status and current update state before archiving a run.

entries.remaster_caveats: Live-service availability and content can change; confirm current server/update state before treating an archive run as final.
